## Objective
- Build a playable, polished “Subway Surfers-style Sly Cooper” endless rooftop runner web game from the near-empty repo.

## Requirements
- User request: `"Subway surfers style sly Cooper game"`.
- Must be a mobile/desktop browser game with responsive layout and touch controls.
- Static site must serve through `start.sh`/`default-start.mjs` (root `index.html`, no unsupported package framework).
- Visual quality should support screenshot-based evaluation; gameplay must be visible shortly after auto-start.
- Capture auto-starts by clicking a visible button with accessible name exactly `Start`/`Play`.

## Decisions
- Built original Sly Cooper-inspired fan tribute using procedural Three.js geometry, textures, animation, and audio; no copyrighted assets.
- Title: `Sly Runs — Rooftop Heist`; three-lane endless runner with jump, slide, lane switching, coins, power-ups, lives, score, heat, pause/game-over screens.
- Use vendored Three.js r160.1 + `BufferGeometryUtils` so no CDN/network dependency.
- Runtime currently static `index.html` + CSS + ES modules.
- Performance optimizations added for SwiftShader: software-GL detection, disabled shadows in low-power mode, reduced DPR (`0.8`), merged static city/track/Eiffel/far-city/obstacles/hero detail, instanced coins.
- Start now enters `state.mode = 'playing'` immediately and snaps camera to chase view, so captures show gameplay despite low software FPS.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html`, `styles.css`, `js/game.js`, vendored Three.js/BufferGeometryUtils, local fonts.
- Implemented 3D scene, animated raccoon hero, obstacle/coin/power-up loops, collisions, HUD, menus, pause/game-over, localStorage best score, keyboard/swipe/touch controls, procedural audio.
- Added merge helper `mergeGroupByMaterial`, low-power renderer config, blob shadow, instanced coins, merged chunks for track/city/far-city/Eiffel/obstacles.
- Fixed `[hidden]` modal CSS bug; fixed hero invisibility caused by `state.laneVelocity` being undefined/NaN.
- Reduced draw calls from ~728 to ~162.
- Verified desktop menu screenshot visually; title screen looks strong and hero visible.
- Screenshot script created at `/tmp/shot.mjs`; server running in tmux session `sly` on `http://localhost:3002`.
- Playwright browser installed after initial missing-browser error.

### Active
- Fixing visual regression after merging `headGroup`: menu screenshot shows a giant misplaced raccoon head floating left and hero head missing/odd. Last edit converts merged geometries to non-indexed and adds missing `uv`/`normal`, but not yet re-tested.
- Need re-capture menu/game screenshots and inspect.
- Need verify `mergeGeometries` console errors are gone.
- Need re-check gameplay screenshot after optimizations and merge fix.

### Blocked
- Software WebGL performance remains low (~3–4 FPS at full res on SwiftShader), but logic now wall-clock based; playable enough for static capture.

## Next Move
1. Run `node /tmp/shot.mjs` and inspect `screenshots/menu-desktop.png` / `screenshots/game-desktop.png`; confirm merge console errors gone.
2. If head still misplaced, temporarily skip `mergeGroupByMaterial(headGroup, ...)` or debug head local transforms; ensure hero head stays attached and menu pose faces camera.
3. Inspect hero back view/gameplay framing; improve tail/head silhouette if needed.
4. Add closer starting coins/obstacles for stronger first gameplay frame if empty foreground remains.
5. Re-test mobile via Playwright viewport 390×844; verify responsive menu/HUD and touch controls.
6. Check start button auto-click/capture behavior, pause/game-over modals, and run `capture.sh`-style desktop/mobile screenshots.
7. Ensure no uncommitted unwanted debug artifacts; clean `window.__slyRuns` if desired (currently intentionally exposed for visual checks).

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/game.js`: main game logic, scene, renderer, merging, all systems.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: DOM, menu, HUD, modals, module entry.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: full UI styling, responsive/touch layout, loader/modal fixes.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/vendor/three.module.js`: vendored Three.js.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/vendor/BufferGeometryUtils.js`: geometry merge utility, import path patched to `./three.module.js`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/assets/fonts/*.woff2`: Bebas, Luckiest Guy, Barlow local fonts.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/`: current menu/game/debug screenshots.
- `/tmp/shot.mjs`: Playwright script taking 1440×900 menu + post-start game screenshots.
- `/tmp/perf.mjs`: draw-call/FPS diagnostic script.
- `/tmp/sly-server.log`: server log.
- `/tmp/game.mjs`: temp copy used for `node --check`.

## Important Context
- Current latest code edit (not yet verified) is in `mergeGroupByMaterial`: converts indexed geometry with `toNonIndexed()`, computes normals if absent, and adds zeroed `uv` if absent.
- Prior console errors observed:
  - `THREE.BufferGeometryUtils: .mergeGeometries() failed with geometry at index 3. All geometries must have compatible attributes...`
  - Similar failures at index 2.
- Head merge visual bug: menu screenshot shows giant head at screen left and no head on hero. Likely caused by head merge transform/attribute issue or merge failure after `root.clear()`.
- Hero NaN bug was caused by `state.laneVelocity` undefined; replaced with `clamp(state.playerX - hero.position.x, -3, 3)`.
- `LOW_POWER` detection uses `WEBGL_debug_renderer_info` regex `/swiftshader|llvmpipe|software|basic render/i`.
- `renderer.shadowMap.enabled = !LOW_POWER`; DPR `0.8` when low power.
- `CHUNK_LEN = 240`; two track/city chunks at z `12` and `-228`; wrap when `z > 12 + CHUNK_LEN` subtract `CHUNK_LEN * 2`.

- Playwright low FPS means screenshots after ~1s may show only a few simulated frames; game logic uses `dt = Math.min(clock.getDelta(), .1)`.
- Start button: `<button id="startBtn" aria-label="Start">` with visible text `START RUN` so capture auto-click matches.
- `[hidden]{display:none!important}` added because `.modal-screen{display:grid}` previously overrode `hidden`.
- `screenshots/` and logs are gitignored; `.agents/` ignored.
